label: FP
reason: The XSS sinks (rememberMe.getValue() and rememberMe.getName()) do not receive user-controlled data. rememberMeKey is generated from SecureRandom.nextDouble(), and rememberMe.getName() derives from hardcoded cookieName construction ('rememberMe' + testCaseNumber from getClass().getName()). Neither receives input from request.parameters() or other user sources.

evidence.note: XSS sinks use non-user-controlled values (random key and class-based cookie name)
